The smallest element of \(T\) is \(1\cdot 2=2\), and \(1\) is not in \(T\).

For every integer \(n\) with \(2\le n\le 2018\), we have
\[
n=1\cdot n
\]
with \(1,n\in S\) and \(1\ne n\). Thus \(2,3,\dots,2018\) are all in \(T\), giving \(2017\) elements.

The next possible integer is \(2019\). Since
\[
2019=3\cdot 673
\]
with \(3,673\in S\) and distinct, \(2019\in T\).

Therefore, the \(2018\)th smallest member of \(T\) is \(\boxed{2019}\).
